returns.name: Employer's Reemployment Assistance Quarterly Report (Form 21 / online wage reporting)
contents: Due the last day of the month after the quarter: April 30, July 31, October 31, January 31; a weekend or holiday date moves to the next business day.
Reports must be RECEIVED by April 30, July 31, October 31 and January 31; the reporting period opens the first day after each quarter.
A zero-wage report is still required, and penalties apply to late zero reports; the late filing penalty is $25 per month or part (plus $25 per month for late payment and 1.5% monthly interest).
Filed online through the Internet Quarterly Wage Reporting System (comma-delimited file upload is possible) or on paper; domestic employers who report annually use Form 21D & E.

notModelled: The comma-delimited upload file layout and the SIDES e-response exchange were not read.
The 2026 rate notice is an input (rate notices were mailed October 31, 2025).
Whether electronic filing is mandatory: the pages call it the fastest and most efficient way, not a requirement.

channels.description: South Dakota Reemployment Assistance Internet Quarterly Wage Reporting System (online or comma-delimited upload); paper reports are accepted
enrollment: Register as an employer with the Reemployment Assistance Tax Unit (605-626-2312); a UserID and password, plus an Authentication Key and Security Code, are needed to report online.

notModelled: South Dakota has no state income tax on wages, so there is no state withholding.
